name: lic-smart-followup
description: LIC Smart Follow-up - offline-first personal insurance CRM and premium due reminder app for Android (PWA + Capacitor).

scripts.test:all: npm run sw:update && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.android:add: cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && python3 scripts/android-icons.py && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run sw:update && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && python3 scripts/android-icons.py
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
